Hybra_Finance_xo4hapwL2Jy__7RVCVStDrsF__.notes: Post-deposit share dilution. P pins the illustrative example values (vault_assets_before == 10000, deposit == 5000) as equalities, narrowing the claim to the example instance (disclosed as an assumption, but over-specific; the dual review flags the same narrowing). I: shares_minted * vault_assets_before >= deposit_amount * total_shares_after. The pairing is correct ONLY under the pre-mint reading of total_shares_after (= S_before, giving exactly the report's fair relation shares*A_before >= deposit*S_before); under the symbol's declared meaning ('total share supply after the deposit is minted' = S_before + shares_minted) the obligation becomes shares*(A_before - deposit) >= deposit*S_before, which the report's own numbers show is violated even by a FAIR implementation (5000*10000 < 5000*15000) and would raise false violations at stage-3 binding. Either the relation or the declared symbol meaning is wrong; the ambiguity itself is the defect. V direction is correct but only the share-percentage impact is represented (fewer-shares and redistribution impacts deferred, disclosed). Dual review independently rates the formal property partial (example-value scoping) without detecting the pairing ambiguity.
